title: Lava Dogs FiST
description: U.S. Marines with Company B, 1st Battalion, 3rd Marine Regiment, conduct a battalion assault course utilizing the fire support team to supress simulated enemy positions during Integrated Training Exercise (ITX)  at Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center Twentynine Palms, Calif., Aug. 12, 2015. ITX is conducted to enhance the integration and warfighting capanility from all elements of the Marine Air Ground Task Force. (U.S. Marine Corps motion imagery produced by Cpl. Akeel Austin/Released)
